context: Kenji and Daichi plant a few trees as part of a town greening event.
purpose: Two friends volunteering for community ecology project.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: この木、しっかり植えよか。
lines.en: Should we plant this one properly?
lines.style: Warm, grounded tone. Open attack on the question. Unhurried pace — the kind of man who takes his time with things that matter. Slight lift at the end, inviting without pressure.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Brief, practical agreement. Soft consonants. Thoughtful pause before the second phrase, as if seeing it happen. A man who knows the work and respects it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 将来、森になるんやろな。
lines.en: It'll become a forest someday, won't it.
lines.style: Quiet, almost wondering. Slow on the middle words. Slight upturn in tone — not quite a question, more like he's seeing ahead. Breath on the end like he's touched something true.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 子供たちにも、見せたい。
lines.en: I want the kids to see it grow.
lines.style: Softer attack. Warm, almost tender — a man thinking of the next generation. Steady pace. Slight trailing-off, like he's imagining it already.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Grounded, philosophical. Light emphasis on the weight of it. Slow, deliberate pace. Quiet authority — not lecturing, just knowing. Breath settles at the end.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええ活動や、こうやって。
lines.en: This is good work, doing it this way.
lines.style: Warm pride without boasting. Steady, measured delivery. Light emphasis on 「good」. A man appreciating something he believes in. Comfortable silence underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Should we come back next year?
lines.style: Gentle invitation, not a command. Open attack. Warm, committed tone. Slight lift at the end — leaving room for agreement. The kind of man who plants for the future.
